```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```
```{r}
antibiotics<- read_csv("ukhsa-chart-download copy.csv")
gt(head(antibiotics))
```
```{r}
ggplot(antibiotics,aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour="black") + 
  xlab("date") +
  ylab("value") +
  ggtitle("Value by date")
```
